name: Inspect & Vacuum Bare Drywall
intent: Walk the bare-drywall walls before primer goes on. Look for high mud spots, paper cuts, fastener pops, and dust. Vacuum loose dust and joint-compound debris off the wall surface. No spackle or sanding here — that's the drywall finisher's scope. This module is the painter's pre-prime walkthrough only.
doctrine: Pre-prime inspection is faster than post-prime inspection (the wall is uniform color and defects are subtle). The painter is checking for things the drywall finisher missed — not redoing the finisher's work. Vacuum is always required before primer because drywall dust prevents primer adhesion. QT2 and QT3 inspect at the same rate; QT4 slows because the painter is hunting for marginal defects to flag back to the finisher.
